modules.web/login-app.mjs: Gate account/text controls for configured PatchEXE until choice; invalidate session/launch/consent; selected metadata prepares full resource context.

modules.adapters/node/launcher-loopback.mjs: Optional gamePatchOrigins runtime descriptor and exact CSP origins; default profile unchanged, no proxy.

files.input: Explicit entries own relativePath and native Blob/File; browser takes intrinsic webkitRelativePath from selected FileList only.
files.format: One nonempty common root removed, slash separator; core relativeASCII path validation/aliases/tree conflicts applies before first payload read.
files.budgets: 1024 files,32MiB each,64MiB aggregate; empty input/file allowed; one bounded read deadline.
files.ownership: Intrinsic Blob.size/slice/arrayBuffer bypass subclass overrides; returned bytes owned. Failure drops owned partials; late delivered buffers wiped; no JS heap-erasure claim.

state.prepare: Clear old candidate before new input validation; snapshot raw catalogs/scalars/origins before asynchronous files; fixed10second monotonic total across file and existing HTTP phases.
state.review: Snapshot has filenames/counts/byte lengths/phase/binding and operation counts only; no payload aliases. Ready is selectable only when no skipped operations or unknown blocks.
state.choice: Explicit choose while ready; selectedPaths returns frozen path strings. Resources derive from these paths; payload remains page-local and unverified.
state.lifecycle: Configuration/game/region/Galaxy/cache restore, directory/path encoding/base folder changes, discard and pagehide clear choice. Cancel aborts current I/O and discards partial results. Generation blocks late providers replacing a new candidate.
state.cleanup: Clear owned candidate file bytes/process plan/manifest byte fields on reset; referenced JS strings/external copies/engine heap not guaranteed erased.

UI.visibility: Only when explicitly configured gamePatch runtime AND current game PatchEXE require preparation; default/no-patch flow retained.
UI.readiness: Configured required patch gates account/text review until explicit complete choice. Choice automatically prepares full process resource input. Errors/cancel/discard do not authorize exchange.
UI.controls: Existing Windows directory/path profile reused; separate base-folder reads payloads. Existing installation-folder input continues metadata-only when no chosen patch.
UI.persistence: No patch bytes/choice persisted. Existing explicit XML cache contains catalog bytes/options, restoration reparses and requires fresh preparation.
UI.scope: All patch application is virtual owned memory; no installed-directory write, upload, automatic process, officialendpoint or authentication assertion.

local_capability.origins: 1..16 unique exact canonical http://127.0.0.1:port; no hostname, LAN, credentials, path, wildcard or HTTPS. Must independently match selected PIP/PPort; BIP is not HTTP permission.
local_capability.runtime: Optional gamePatch:{schema:moli.local-game-patch.v1,allowedOrigins}. Absent by default; exact configured origins only appended to connect-src.
local_capability.source: Original fixture CORS permits only its exact login origin; transport still omits credentials/referrer and rejects redirects. Node adapter exposes no HTTP proxy, new routes or official defaults.
local_capability.offline: Existing4173 offline page retains connect-src none; optional capability only affects opt-in session server.

not_implemented: Native installation commit/rollback, real filesystem changes or patcher process
Official update trust/signatures and real packages/accounts/service acceptance
